projects.title: Transit Timetable Query Performance Capstone
bullets: Loaded public transit timetable tables into a SQLite relational database within a supervised undergraduate capstone team project.
Compared indexed and unindexed queries on public transit timetable data using Python, SQL, and SQLite.

research.title: Bibliographic Data Query Performance Research
bullets: Wrote aggregation and join queries for public bibliographic tables in SQLite as a student research assistant under faculty supervision.
Documented query plans and compared indexed and unindexed SQL queries to examine query performance on public bibliographic data.
